newsitem.title: USA: Synalloy sees improving metals results.
newsitem.headline: Synalloy sees improving metals results.

text.p: Synalloy Corp said Tuesday it expected products from its pipe unit to produce better results in the second half of the year following a poor performance in the first half.

"These products (piping systems and process equipment) should produce much better results in the second half since backlogs are at a good level, up 84 percent from a year earlier," it said in a statement. Synalloy, a producer of stainless steel pipe and other products, said dollar sales were down during the second quarter because of lower sales prices and the shift in product mix.

"The disappointing results from piping systems and process equipment were exacerbated by customer delays in certain production schedules and $115,000 expensed for the start-up costs of a carbon pipe fabrication shop," it said.
The metals segment, under which the pipe unit operates, had second quarter revenues totalling $17.0 million against $21.6 million for the same period a year ago.
The company's other segment, chemicals, brought in $14.2 million in revenues against $10.1 million.
Synalloy reported a second-quarter profit of $0.20 a share against $0.30 last year.
